labels.shortDescription: Segments: the person lacks the Find permission
labels.value: Donor segments are Find queries, so they need the BarnCRM Find and Export permission set. Ask your administrator for it.

labels.shortDescription: Segments: the segment is missing or not visible
labels.value: That segment was not found. It may have been deleted, or it is no longer shared with you.

labels.shortDescription: Segments: a saved query not of people or organizations
labels.value: Only a saved query of people or organizations can be used as a donor segment.

labels.shortDescription: Segments: the template does not apply to the choice
labels.value: That template is not available for the records you chose.

labels.shortDescription: Segments: the segment name is blank or too long
labels.value: Give the segment a name of 80 characters or fewer.

labels.shortDescription: Segments: an email tool layout on an organization segment
labels.value: The Mailchimp and Constant Contact layouts are for people. Export an organization segment with All Columns.

labels.shortDescription: Segments: an export layout that does not exist
labels.value: Choose Mailchimp, Constant Contact or All Columns for the export.
